scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:electron && npm run build:native
scripts.build:native: sdk_path=$(xcrun --sdk macosx --show-sdk-path) && mkdir -p dist-native /private/tmp/icarus-swift-modules && { if [ ! -x dist-native/icarus-keychain ] || ! shasum -a 256 -c dist-native/keychain.sha256 >/dev/null 2>&1; then swiftc -sdk "$sdk_path" -module-cache-path /private/tmp/icarus-swift-modules native/keychain.swift -o dist-native/icarus-keychain && shasum -a 256 native/keychain.swift > dist-native/keychain.sha256; fi; } && swiftc -sdk "$sdk_path" -module-cache-path /private/tmp/icarus-swift-modules native/selection.swift -o dist-native/icarus-selection
